The '''1976–77 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], nine points ahead of [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]] and [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]] were relegated.
